facts.value: Headless Chromium WebGL2 (GLSL ES 3.00, ANGLE SwiftShader Vulkan, 1280x720).
WebGL2 '#version 300 es' MUST start on line 1 col 0 (no leading newline), use 'in'/'out' (NEVER 'attribute'/'varying'), and declare 'out vec4 fragColor' (NEVER 'gl_FragColor').
100% self-contained single HTML file; ZERO external CDN fetches allowed.

WebGL Float32Array(16) is column-major: m[3]=0, m[7]=0, m[11]=0, m[15]=1 for affine/view/ortho matrices! Exact lookAt(eye,target,up) Float32Array(16) with f=norm(eye-target), r=norm(cross(up,f)), u=cross(f,r): [rx,ux,fx,0,  ry,uy,fy,0,  rz,uz,fz,0,  -dot(r,eye),-dot(u,eye),-dot(f,eye),1]. NEVER put -dot(...) at m[3],m[7],m[11]! Upload every active mat4 uniform before draw.
Game must start immediately playable (state='playing') on load without blocking modals, and update window.__GAME_STATE__ every frame.
